InstitutionFacilityService

class InstitutionFacilityService(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: QObject

Business rules (service layer) of institution facilities.

A single instance is shared by the whole application.

Parameters:
daoInstitutionFacilityCsvDAO | None, optional

DAO used for persistence. Default is None, which creates a new InstitutionFacilityCsvDAO.

Attributes:
institutionfacility_changeSignal(int)

Emitted after a change: with the ID of the created or updated institution facility, or with 0 after a deletion.

daoInstitutionFacilityCsvDAO

DAO used for persistence.

Notes

__new__ always returns the same instance, and __init__ sets it up only once: a dao passed in later calls is ignored.

get_all_institutionfacilities()[source]

Return all registered institution facilities.

Returns:
list[InstitutionFacility]

The institution facilities cached by the DAO.

validate_data(data)[source]

Validate the form data of an institution facility.

Parameters:
datadict[str, Any]

Form data.

Returns:
list[str]

Translated error messages, each ending with a newline; empty when the data is valid.

Notes

The id is required and must be an int; name must not be blank; type must not be 0.

The messages (pt_BR source texts) are translated at runtime with self.tr().

create_institutionfacility(data)[source]

Create an institution facility from a dictionary.

Parameters:
datadict[str, Any]

Values for every InstitutionFacility field. An id of 0 or less gets the next free ID.

Returns:
InstitutionFacility | None

The created institution facility, or None if it is not valid or its ID already exists.

Raises:
TypeError

If data misses a field or has an unknown key.

Notes

institutionfacility_change is emitted with the new ID on success.

update_institutionfacility(institutionfacility_id, data)[source]

Update an existing institution facility with new values.

Parameters:
institutionfacility_idint

ID of the institution facility to update.

datadict[str, Any]

Updated fields; missing keys keep the current value.

Returns:
bool

True if the institution facility was found, is valid and was saved; False otherwise.

Notes

The cached object is changed in place before validation, so an invalid update still changes it in memory. institutionfacility_change is emitted with the ID on success.

delete_institutionfacility(institutionfacility_id)[source]

Delete an institution facility by its ID.

Parameters:
institutionfacility_idint

ID of the institution facility to delete.

Returns:
bool

True if deleted, False if the institution facility was not found.

Raises:
BusinessRuleException

If a professional is linked to the facility; the message is translated with self.tr().

Notes

institutionfacility_change is emitted with 0 on success. A professional without a facility (None) makes the check raise AttributeError.
